scoring_method: Each dimension is scored from 0 to 100 and multiplied by its weight. Only reproducible local evidence, code/test evidence, or explicitly documented evidence receives credit. The score is not a production SLA, capacity result, or security certification.

dimensions.name: requirements_and_core_functionality
dimensions.evidence: Stages 0-19 cover authentication, organization, projects/tasks, comments, attachments, reminders, notifications, audit, frontend and deployment paths; Stage 3 adds 9 Playwright scenarios but the last reproducible run is 4/9, so full browser coverage and malware scanning remain incomplete.

dimensions.name: architecture_and_explainability
dimensions.evidence: The modular monolith has explicit MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO boundaries, state-machine validation, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and compensation paths; the topology is still local-learning oriented.

dimensions.name: security_and_data_protection
dimensions.evidence: Stage 1 security controls remain verified; Stage 2 adds official npm audit visibility with 0 high/critical findings at this lockfile snapshot, while OWASP/NVD did not complete locally and no dependency result is treated as a production security guarantee. localStorage tokens, plaintext local transport, external Secret Manager/rotation, and production proxy isolation remain material gaps.

dimensions.name: tests_builds_and_regression
dimensions.evidence: Maven 67 tests with 0 failures and 1 optional skip, explicit Testcontainers verification, JaCoCo report and gate, frontend typecheck/build, Compose config and Kind verification are recorded; Playwright has 9 scenarios with a last reproducible 4/9 result, so browser E2E is not complete.

dimensions.name: evaluation_and_observability
dimensions.evidence: A fixed local performance baseline, protected runtime metrics, EXPLAIN output, Actuator metrics, JaCoCo XML/HTML, dependency scans, and new Redis/RabbitMQ/MinIO fault-before/during/after snapshots with MySQL count comparisons exist; official npm audit completed, while OWASP/NVD timed out, same-parameter replay is blocked, and real Rabbit retry/DLQ/replay remains incomplete.

dimensions.name: runtime_integration_and_recovery_readiness
dimensions.evidence: Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO short stop/start recovery passed with unchanged observed MySQL facts; six-service Compose health, prior persistent restart, Kind application probes, pod recovery and rolling restart passed. MySQL was not re-injected in Stage 5, browser WebSocket reconnect was not verified, middleware remains single-instance, and there is no production Ingress/TLS/HPA/multi-node HA evidence.

dimensions.name: engineering_governance
dimensions.evidence: Two readable GitHub Actions workflows now separate fast checks from Testcontainers/coverage/security jobs; JaCoCo gates and scan policies are configured, but workflows have not yet executed on the remote repository and actionlint is not installed locally.

dimensions.name: documentation_and_delivery_credibility
dimensions.evidence: README, CHANGELOG, stage documents, Chinese interview material and the acceptance report distinguish local evidence from production claims.
